responsibility: This header defines the `thunderx_tunings` model for the original Cavium ThunderX core in the AArch64 backend. It provides ThunderX-specific register-move costs, AdvSIMD vector costs, prefetch behavior, issue rate, fusion mask, and tune flags such as cheap shift-extend handling, supplying the microarchitectural cost model that matches the separate ThunderX scheduler description for code tuned to this CPU family.
same_name_distinction: This `thunderx` file is the tuning-model header under `tuning_models/`: unlike `gcc/config/aarch64/thunderx.md`, which describes scheduler automata and instruction reservations for ThunderX, it supplies the `thunderx_tunings` cost tables and heuristic parameters used for non-scheduling code-generation decisions.
